definition: A neural architecture based on self-attention rather than recurrence or convolution, the foundation of modern LLMs.
details: The Transformer processes entire sequences in parallel, using multi-head self-attention to model pairwise relationships and positional encodings to retain order. Removing recurrence made training dramatically more parallelizable, enabling the scaling that produced GPT, BERT and today’s large language models.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. Boil it down and it is this: A neural architecture based on self-attention rather than recurrence or convolution, the foundation of modern LLMs. Here is why it matters: The Transformer processes entire sequences in parallel, using multi-head self-attention to model pairwise relationships and positional encodings to retain order. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Transformer.
